name: BetterHelp
one_liner: BetterHelp is the world's largest online therapy platform, connecting over 2 million users with licensed therapists for messaging, phone, and video sessions.
best_for: People who want convenient access to therapy from home
Those who prefer messaging-based therapy alongside live sessions
People with busy schedules who need flexible appointment times
Those who have difficulty accessing in-person therapy
People comfortable with subscription-based therapy pricing
not_for: People in crisis or needing immediate intervention
Those requiring specialized treatment (eating disorders, severe trauma, etc.)
People who need psychiatric medication (BetterHelp is therapy only)
Those who prefer traditional in-person therapy relationships
short_description: Largest online therapy platform with licensed therapists via messaging, phone, and video. Subscription-based.
long_description: BetterHelp is the world's largest online therapy platform, connecting users with licensed therapists for counseling via text messaging, live chat, phone calls, and video sessions. After completing an intake questionnaire, you're matched with a therapist. If the match isn't right, you can switch therapists at no extra cost. BetterHelp therapists are licensed professionals (LPC, LMFT, LCSW, etc.) in their state. The platform uses a subscription model with unlimited messaging and weekly live sessions.
patient_summary: BetterHelp connects you with a licensed therapist you can message anytime and meet with via video or phone weekly. It's like having a therapist in your pocket, available around your schedule.

pricing.notes: Subscription required. $260-$400/month depending on plan. Financial aid available. Some employers offer as benefit.

privacy.notes: Not HIPAA compliant by design (platform model). Has faced privacy scrutiny. Your messages are encrypted.

seo.title: BetterHelp: Online Therapy Platform Review | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: BetterHelp is the largest online therapy platform. Messaging + video sessions with licensed therapists. $65-100/week. 4.5★ rating. Pros, cons, and alternatives.

faqs.a: Yes. BetterHelp therapists are licensed professionals (LPC, LMFT, LCSW, etc.) providing real therapy. Research shows online therapy can be as effective as in-person therapy for many conditions.
BetterHelp costs $65-100 per week ($260-400/month) depending on your location and plan. This includes unlimited messaging and weekly live sessions. Financial aid is available for those who qualify.

BetterHelp generally doesn't accept insurance directly. However, some employers offer it as a benefit, and you may be able to use HSA/FSA funds. You can request a superbill for potential out-of-network reimbursement.

faqs.q: How is BetterHelp different from Talkspace?
faqs.a: Both are major online therapy platforms. BetterHelp is larger with more therapists. Talkspace has more insurance partnerships. Pricing and features are similar. Many people try both to compare therapist match quality.
